text: Newly promoted records must have nonblank text and no duplicate exact text within the batch. The post-promotion verification filters records to the candidate IDs promoted in this front and checks that every text field is non-empty after stripping whitespace. It then asserts that the number of unique texts equals the number of promoted records. Pre-existing blank records from older historical fronts should not cause a failure because they were introduced before the current front's governance rules. The 09B front found nine pre-existing blank records in canonical memory but confirmed that all twelve new candidates had clean text. The 09C front must apply the same policy: report pre-existing blanks as warnings but fail only if the current batch introduced them. This distinction preserves backward compatibility while maintaining quality gates.
summary: Newly promoted records must have nonblank text and no batch duplicates
